scope: Native PromQL root range function optimization on cumulative R40 compiler: for a direct RangeSelector with a single exact non-empty __name__ and no parent AST node, defer metric-name stripping from per-series vector-grid group-ID collector to the final result serialization. In finalizer, filter __name__ from output tags after timeSeriesGroupToTags(group), preserving sorted labels and injectivity, with no projected group-registration, no changed sample reads. Change only SQLQueryPiece.h, applyFunctionOverRange.cpp and finalizeSQL.cpp; baseline R40 source-matched O2 jemalloc. Not R36/R39/R34 or data layout changes.
hypothesis: For root rate/avg_over_time(fixed_metric{labels}[window]), R37 currently registers an additional projected group for every source series. The root result never reuses group IDs downstream. Removing __name__ only in final tag-array generation avoids those intermediate group registrations, hashes and locks while keeping PromQL output identical.
